runtime_dispatch_drift.interpretation: Read-only provider inspection confirms all 53 canonical module_read branches plus the dedicated consultancy intake write branch (54/54). The live dispatcher definition hash is 6441f11c033610c0e227f01386b487bd. The live omega_private.create_consult_intake helper returns text and is consistent with the provider-applied 20261112130000 compatibility migration; consult_requests.id remains bigint and is returned as text. The source migration chain now replays from zero. On PR #1265 head e366d4099e93af0b562cdee953ba7ef3df05f7d6, all 54 runtime adapter actions, family-access authorization/privacy probes, and authenticated content-pipeline E2E passed. Production exact-SHA verification remains a separate release gate.

idempotency_observations.interpretation: The live schema contains globally unique idempotency keys on member-owned records. The same caller-supplied key can collide across users or subjects. The reconciliation migration replaces these with owner/subject-scoped unique indexes while retaining global deduplication for system rows with null owner/actor where applicable. This is a schema/function finding, not proof of an observed exploit.
